listing.name: Luddic Enhancement IED Ships
listing.summary: Due to popular demand, I have split off the IED ships into their own mod. This mod does not need Luddic Enhancement, and Luddic ENhancement does not need this mod. This mod adds IED ships, specifically a dram, a phaeton, and a Prometheus, which explode, taking ships out in the near vicinity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds exploding ships that damage nearby vessels.
